opener_episode.title: Inside Black Markets, 9/11 & Cartel TAKEOVER
opener_episode.why: Recent (within ~60 days) episode about how hidden markets really move money and goods; Avery can offer the legal, glamorous counterpart: how the opaque high-end art market actually prices and sells. Pair with the strongest proof point: Julian already hosted David Packouz ('War Dogs' Gun Lord..., ep #213), and Packouz was also a guest on Avery's ArtLife podcast - a shared-guest bridge.

angles.headline: The other War Dogs guy's art dealer: hustle, money and the opaque art market
angles.pitch: Avery, who interviewed David Packouz on his own ArtLife podcast, walks through how he built ArtLife into an eight-figure online blue-chip gallery and why art pricing is one of the last unregulated money games.
angles.builds_on: Julian's Packouz episode (#213) and the Mariana van Zeller black-markets episode (Aug 14, 2026)

angles.headline: Michael Cohen's prison badge as an NFT: inside the 2021 NFT gold rush
angles.pitch: Avery's ArtGrails sold Michael Cohen's prison badge as an NFT (Vanity Fair) and launched with Ozuna (Rolling Stone), a first-hand story of politics, celebrity and crypto money colliding.
angles.builds_on: Julian's past NFT episodes (#94 Giovanni Gussen, #37 NBA Top Shot) and his politics/power episodes

angles.headline: Supra-elites and their art: what the very rich and famous really ask for
angles.pitch: Avery advises celebrities, athletes and HNW collectors (placed a $100K+ Hap Tivey with Kris Jenner at Art Basel Miami Beach 2024; Scott Disick's $57K Helmut Newton) and can tell, in Julian's documentary-style long arc, how fame and money behave in the art world.

format: Long-form video podcast (2-4 hours), recorded in a New York City studio, in person. Documentary-style arc (childhood and motive first, headline events later). Guests: ex-CIA, whistleblowers, cartel insiders, investigative authors, hustler-entrepreneurs (e.g., David Packouz). ~1.3-1.4M YouTube subscribers. Also runs news/commentary episodes and a 'Julian Dorey Daily' feed. Produced under Daylight Media.
